The '''Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor''' was a walkway across the [[tractor beam power-generator trench]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was here that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took out [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327's]] [[Tractor Beam 12/Legends|tractor beam]], ultimately allowing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to flee.<ref name="ANH" />
